pro_course_detail.title: Language Essentials --All Levels/adults, teens (7+ of age)
pro_course_detail.description:
In general English, I have personalized resources  structured in different levels to cater to leaners with varying proficiency levels. Each level focuses on specific language skills, vocabulary, and grammar rules to help students develop their language skills in speaking, listening , reading, and writing. These courses are divided into different  levels based on the student. In the blog post, we will discuss the different levels of general English that   that will help you. Also, get ready to improve your knowledge of everyday  English and life events and learn the language.

Beginner (A1)
This is the starting level for learners who have little or no knowledge of the English language. It focuses on basic vocabulary and grammar rules, including sentence structure, verb tenses, pronouns, learn common phrases and expressions for daily use. For example, students at this level might learn how to introduce themselves, ask for directions, or order food at a restaurant.

Elementary (A2) 
At this level, students will learn to communicate in simple and basic English. This level is for learners who can understand and use basic English phrases and expressions. It builds on the vocabulary and grammar learned  at the beginner level and students will be able to construct more complex sentences. For example, students might learn how to describe their daily routine or talk about their hobbies and interests in proper sentences and include topics such as work, leisure, travel, and family.

Intermediate (B1) 
This General English level focuses on making students hold a conversation in English and understand more complex sentences. It covers topics such as expressing opinions, discussing current events, and giving presentations confidently. Students will also learn more advanced grammar and vocabulary, and will be able to read and understand more complex texts. 
Upper intermediate (B2)
This level is for learners who are comfortable with using English in various situations.
